Tia (docs): Opening a tiny PR to add clear examples for function/tool-calling structured outputs (nested arrays, missing optional fields) + recommended guardrails. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1502
Sam (eng-runtime): Please note runtime fallback: on parse failures we emit telemetry `parse_shim_applied` and try compact-envelope coercion. Callers see route flags parsed=true/false.
Jordan (devex): Will add a streaming-safe JS snippet and a non-streaming Python retry example. Add a sample prompt that reproduces nested arrays: 'Return actions as [[{"name":"x"}]]'.
Maria (sdk): JS snippet: ```js
const r = await client.responses.create({model:'rw-open-7b', input: prompt});
try { const data = JSON.parse(r.output_text); } catch { const data = client.responses.parse_shim(r.output_text); }
```
Anya (qa): I'll add a tiny automated test that asserts parse_shim_applied telemetry fires for malformed JSON.
Tia (docs): Also found stale anchors under /tooling/structured-output; Jordan can you run link-checker and add redirects?
Jordan (devex): On it. I'll patch CI to fail on anchor rot.
deploy-bot: Preview for PR #1502: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.dev/docs/1502 (checks: lint pass, link-checker anchors flagged)
Tia (docs): Plan: update PR with snippets, telemetry note, QA test, and anchor fixes. Target merge tomorrow AM. :shipit:
file_notes: Short Slack coordination thread for a docs PR: structured output / tool-calling examples, parser shim/fallback mention, JS/Python SDK snippets, QA test, and link fixes. Includes a deploy preview link and inline code snippets.
